title: 군인의 시간외근무수당 등에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text: Article 3 (Working Hours, etc. of Military Personnel) Working hours and working days for military personnel shall be determined by the Minister of National Defense, taking into consideration the importance of their responsibilities and duties and the particular characteristics of their status and working conditions: Provided, That the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, the Chiefs of Staff of each armed service, the Commandant of the Marine Corps, the heads of units directly under the Ministry of National Defense, and the heads of agencies directly under the Ministry of National Defense may, where they deem it necessary in view of the nature of duties or the particular characteristics of a region or agency, separately determine the working hours and working days of military personnel under their command with the approval of the Minister of National Defense.
